title: [checkout] Migrate OTLP exporters from gRPC to http/protobuf
author: cijothomas
body:
Migrates `checkout`'s OTLP exporters (traces, metrics, logs) from gRPC to http/protobuf, per #2676.

Verified locally: traces, metrics, and logs all confirmed flowing after the switch.

Will follow up with Helm update PR after this is in.
